action-double-dip.title: Double Dip
action-double-dip.text: You may play a second card this turn.

action-no-take-backsies.title: No Take-Backsies
action-no-take-backsies.text: No reaction window opens for the rest of this turn.

action-critical-success.title: Critical Success
action-critical-success.text: Roll twice and keep the higher result.

action-angel-die.title: Angel Die
action-angel-die.text: Add a D8 to your roll.

reaction-critical-failure.title: Critical Failure
reaction-critical-failure.text: The roll happens twice and the lower result counts.

reaction-devil-die.title: Devil Die
reaction-devil-die.text: Subtract a D8 from the roll. If it falls to 0, nobody moves.

reaction-nuehue.title: Nühü
reaction-nuehue.text: The card that opened this window does nothing.

reaction-hold-pawn.title: Hold Pawn
reaction-hold-pawn.text: One opponent's pawn sits this turn out.

reaction-the-purge.title: The Purge
reaction-the-purge.text: For one round every landing captures, own pawns included.

action-banana-peel.title: Banana Peel
action-banana-peel.text: Lay a trap on a square. Whoever touches it slips and loses their next turn with that pawn.

action-hyperbeam.title: Hyperbeam
action-hyperbeam.text: Choose one of your own pawns and a direction, then roll a D4. Everything on the squares ahead goes back to the start area. The pawn that fired is safe, your other pawns are not.

reaction-uno-reverse.title: Uno Reverse
reaction-uno-reverse.text: The capture backfires: the attacker goes back to its own start area.

action-rock.title: Rock
action-rock.text: One of your own pawns becomes a wall nothing gets past, for two rounds.

action-big-ah-rock.title: Big Ah Rock
action-big-ah-rock.text: Turn one square into a boulder for three rounds, and knock the nearest enemy pawn behind it back three squares.

action-oil-spill.title: Oil Spill
action-oil-spill.text: Lay a trap on a square. Whoever touches it slides 3 to 5 squares further and sets off no skill square.

reaction-ghost-mode.title: Ghost Mode
reaction-ghost-mode.text: You dodge: the declared move does not happen.

action-head-out.title: Aight Imma Head Out
action-head-out.text: One of your own pawns jumps four squares forward, or returns to your entry square. Your choice.

action-speedrun.title: Speedrun Any%
action-speedrun.text: Your roll is doubled. Too far is still too far.

action-janky-rpg.title: Janky RPG
action-janky-rpg.text: Choose a square and roll a D6. On a 4 or better it hits that square, below that both its neighbours.

action-yeet.title: Yeet
action-yeet.text: Roll a D6 and push one opponent's pawn back that far.

action-tax-fraud.title: Tax Fraud
action-tax-fraud.text: Take one card at random out of an opponent's hand.

action-lock-in.title: Lock In
action-lock-in.text: One of your own pawns stays put for a round and cannot be captured while it does.

action-not-that-deep.title: It's Not That Deep
action-not-that-deep.text: Lay a trap on a square. Whoever touches it is pushed back one square.

action-let-him-cook.title: Let Him Cook
action-let-him-cook.text: Roll a D12 and run. If the run goes past home, the pawn goes back to the start area.

action-built-different.title: Built Different
action-built-different.text: One of your own pawns cannot be captured for two rounds.

action-fr-fr.title: FR FR
action-fr-fr.text: Name a number instead of rolling.

action-sixty-seven.text: Playable on a D6 or larger only. Below a 6 nothing moves. On a 6 or better the roll counts double.

action-ragebait.title: Ragebait
action-ragebait.text: If the named opponent pawn can move, its owner has to move it.
